shots.text: Under Pearlhaven we brought down the Tidal Leviathan, an eel of grey ice as long as the harbour. It broke apart, and Thalassa rose out of the water.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The ice-eel collapsing; drowned bronze bells rising out of the water and ringing. Thalassa rising from the sea, sea-glass and current, the bells floating in her hair.

shots.text: I remember every ship that ever sailed this sea, and every child on it. I drowned some of them this winter. I will remember that too.
shots.speaker: thalassa
shots.art_note: Thalassa looking down at the towers and heroes.

shots.text:
The sea lay down under the ice, and the holes froze over. That night Mirelle looked into the ice for a long time. She said she had seen a death at the very end of the war.

She would not say whose.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Mirelle alone on the shore with the ice staff, her blind eyes glowing, reflections in the ice of something we cannot make out. Behind her, the black holes in the harbour freezing over.
